notes.title: Support Story Games! 15% off During Release Week
notes.notes: We wanted to make sure everyone got a release sale and shot at supporting Kidalang for their first release this year! Until June 17th there's a 15% discount anyone can get for One Small Fire at a Time. Show Steam and the community you support story-based games!
